The HWPX generation failed because the 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the XML output sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError when searching for 'High (즉시조치)' in the combined XML content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, the verifier reward regressed to 0.00. Avoid assuming that summary values are automatically mapped to the correct Korean severity strings in the HWPML output; ensure the exact formatted string 'High (즉시조치)' is present in the generated <hp:t> tags.
